summary: Chat input with an aurora border and an effort chip; Enter sends and fires a `send` event with the text and effort level.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Model name shown as plain text in the toolbar. Observed.

attributes.name: effort
attributes.description: Effort level, case-insensitive. An unrecognised value selects `High`. Observed: a change selects the level without an `effort` event.

events.name: send
events.description: Fires when a non-empty message is sent. `text` is trimmed; `effort` is the level label (`Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Max` or `Ultracode`). The textarea is then cleared.

events.name: effort
events.description: Fires when the user cycles the effort chip. `effort` is the new level label.

keyboard.action: Send the message. Ignored during IME composition.

accessibility: The textarea has `aria-label="Message"`. The canvas is `aria-hidden`.
The effort chip is a native button labelled `Effort: <level>. Click to change.`
The send button is a native button labelled `Send` and is disabled while the textarea is empty. Sending with it moves focus back to the textarea.
A status line in an `aria-live="polite"` region shows the keyboard hint and, for 2.6 s after sending, the effort used.
motion: With reduced motion the aurora is drawn once and does not move, the send wave and sparks are skipped, and the chip and status text swap without rolling.
notes: All attributes are observed. The textarea's native `input` events stop at the shadow root.
The chip cycles Low, Medium, High, Max, Ultracode and back to Low. Ultracode brightens the band.
The textarea grows with its content up to 160px.
